saw_lines: Skin traders judge trading sites on one thing first: whether a trade completes fast and safely, before they read any feature.
So speed and safety have to be proven on the first screen, or a new trader clicks away to a rival.
Your site shows 18,000 reviews and a 4.7 rating, so open the next Google text ads with those two numbers, not a feature list.
ads_1: Google text ads that lead with trade speed and the 18,000 reviews
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter and YouTube
